verses: Fretted the waters seem, Yet gently flows the stream;-- Unable a fagot to bear. Guarding Shin here we roam, Wives and children at home, All absent our toils who should share. We think of them ever; Thought parts from them never;-- What month shall we homeward repair?

Fretted the waters seem, Yet gently flows the stream;-- A bundle of thorns twill not bear. Guarding Fu here we roam, Wives and children at home, All absent our toils who should share. We think of them ever; Thought parts from them never;-- What month shall we homeward repair?

Fretted the waters seem, Yet gently flows the stream; The reed bundle powerless to bear. Guarding Hsu here we roam, Wives and children at home, All absent our toils who should share. We think of them ever; Thought parts from them never;-- What month shall we homeward repair?
